name: Dock bounce
oneLiner: a glass desktop dock rises, a cursor glides along it and the icons swell under it, it clicks the brand's app, the icon bounces three times with a squash on every landing and its window springs open out of the icon onto the brand's real screen
say: when the speaker opens the tool or says 'I just open it up': the click lands on 'open', the window springs out on the product's name
